rubric.E: explicit pointer: the text tells the agent to read, follow, fetch, check or consult the link, lists it in a task-to-document lookup table, or uses it in a download or run command
rubric.R: reference link: a documentation or source link offered without a directive
rubric.B: service endpoint, tool input or user-specific page: an API URL, MCP server, dashboard or example site passed to a tool
rubric.N: not acted on by the agent: placeholder, namespace, licence, configuration value, example application code, citation or link meant for the human user
